how_to_apply: Prepare your application along with a brief bio-data.
Compile self-attested copies of certificates and supporting documents.
Ensure you fulfill the prescribed qualification and eligibility conditions.
Send your complete application through email to the Director of Academics, Puducherry Technological University at [email protected] with a copy (cc) to [email protected].
Submit the application on or before 11.10.2026 by 5.00 PM.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a Short-Term Contract (STC) and hourly basis and shall not confer any right for regular appointment in the University. The engagement will be for a period of six months. The selected candidate shall be required to undertake teaching, laboratory, academic and other related duties assigned by the Department. Candidates claiming reservation under the OBC category shall produce valid documentary proof issued by the competent authority at the time of selection. Candidates shall produce original certificates/documents relating to educational qualification, experience, community/category and other relevant credentials at the time of interview/selection. The University reserves the right to cancel, modify or withdraw the notification, or not to fill the position, without assigning any reason. Only candidates fulfilling the prescribed qualification and eligibility conditions shall be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: Puducherry Technological University has released a notification for the engagement of One Short-Term Contract (STC) Faculty on an hourly basis in the Mechatronics Programme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 11.10.2026 up to 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechatronics or M.E./M.Tech. in Mechatronics with first class from a recognized University/Institution with specialization in Mechatronics either in UG or PG or both.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reservation category for this post?
faq.answer: The reservation category for the post is OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 750 per hour up to a maximum of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their application along with a brief bio-data and self-attested copies of certificates via email to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement will be for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The date and time of the interview/selection will be intimated later.
